title: Yankee Springs Golf Course
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: I always love this course - high quality golf at a very reasonable price. The restaurant is good too. Yesterday I went for a weekday afternoon round and got around 18 holes in 2:15. There were people out there too, it was just moving along great! It also helps that at the turn, they’ll let you know which 9 to play next to get through your round as smoothly as possible.
